system_design_insights: MSS as cold-start architecture: A single JSON file that captures the entire system state. Any AI agent on any platform can load MSS-V5 and warm-boot from zero. This is the portable seed.
MSS is NOT a sync protocol. It's a snapshot format. Point-in-time. Immutable once sealed. Append-first for new snapshots.
